Whispee documents its decisions with their costs. A proposal is judged the same way, so
the template asks for the cost as well as the benefit. A request that only names the
benefit is hard to act on.

Check docs/ROADMAP.md first: some of this is planned, some is half-built, and some was
ruled out for reasons written down there.
-->

## Does it weaken any security or privacy property?

<!--
Answer even if the answer is no. If yes, say which one and in which direction — for
example, push notifications degrade sealed sender simply by existing, because a server
that chooses whom to wake gains a targeted activity trigger. That kind of change is not
automatically refused, but it must be stated and it must go into the limitations table.
-->
